title: Professional practice
content:
I have been a patient with Friarsgate for nearly forty years and I can honestly say the exemplary service has always been consistently caring and professional. 
I have often spoken to friends and colleagues in other areas of the country and quickly realised they are unable to see a doctor at short notice and sadly have become  completely disillusioned .
We are so fortunate to have our wonderful and super efficient Friarsgate Practice in Winchester. 
Thank you .
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
